body:
This isn't very rigorous, but I guess every implementer will be able to figure it out. If you want to make it rigorous, then I think you'd want to do something like:

1. Let _codePoint_ be null.
2. For each `Text` node _text_ that is a descendant of _element_:
    1. Let _maybeCodePoint_ be the first code point in _text_'s data that is of bidirectional character type L, AL, or R, or null if no such code point exists.
    2. If _maybeCodePoint_ is null, then continue.
    3. If _text_ has an ancestor element _ancestor_ such that _ancestor_ is a descendant of _element_ and _ancestor_ is one of: [...], then continue.
    4. Set _codePoint_ to _maybeCodePoint_ and break.
